verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native access review workflow. It reminds teams to start reviews on their policy's timelines, suggests the in-scope critical systems to review, and validates access changes before the review is finished. It also offers consecutive-review automation (Head Start) and automates gathering of review evidence for audits. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that user lists are pulled from connected-app integrations, documented reviewer sign-off/attestation mechanics, clarity on the 'when applicable' caveat for evidence landing in the evidence library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
